episodes.title: The Cult That Jared Leto Runs (with Shannon McNamara)
episodes.description: Jared Leto started his career as a 23 year old teen heartthrob on “My So Called Life.” He then went on to achieve the nearly impossible: dual careers as both a rock star and a critically acclaimed actor. Recent bombshell reporting from the BBC has revealed that over decades, as he's enjoyed wild success, Leto has allegedly assaulted a staggering number of teenaged girls. Oh, and also he appears to have started a cult. Joining Tess to talk through Leto's apparent history of predatory behavior is podcaster Shannon McNamara @fluentlyforward , host of the Fluently Forward podcast.
